limitations: CPU report arithmetic only; weights and heads.npz omitted; no neural inference, fitting or updates.

Shared source already learned activity; activity decoder degradation does not prove absence of activity in the embedding.

All alignment best checkpoints are epoch0 fallback with untrained auxiliary heads. Evaluate last to diagnose learned alignment; do not relabel last as selected best.
